title.en: When Game Night Stops Being Fun, What Is Your Reset?
title.zh: 游戏没那么好玩了：你会怎样重新安排？

description.en: Six casual game-night choices about checking the table, changing one part of a round and choosing a comfortable finish. Find your reset role.
description.zh: 六次休闲游戏选择，问问同桌感受、只改一处玩法，或自在结束，发现你的重新安排方式。

introduction.en: Imagine a friendly game where someone says the current round is no longer enjoyable. Everyone can pause or stop. The quiz follows the next small group decision, not emotional diagnosis, conflict expertise or a measure of loyalty to the team.
introduction.zh: 想象友好游戏里，有人说当前这一轮不太好玩了。任何人可暂停或停止。题目只跟随下一次小共同决定，不做情绪诊断、冲突专业评价或团队忠诚测量。

focus.en: Responding to an explicitly stated loss of fun through a check-in, a bounded change or a clear ending.
focus.zh: 当有人明确说不再好玩时，通过询问、小范围调整或清楚结束来回应。

prompt.en: A player says the round is no longer fun. You first…
prompt.zh: 玩家说这一轮不再好玩，你先……

label.en: Ask what they would prefer next, without guessing the reason.
label.zh: 问接着希望怎样，不先猜原因。

label.en: Offer one specific change the group could choose to try.
label.zh: 提供一个群体可选择尝试的具体变化。

label.en: Make stopping this round a clear acceptable option.
label.zh: 明确说这一轮可以停下。

prompt.en: The group wants different things from the game. You…
prompt.zh: 小组想从游戏获得的东西不同，你会……

label.en: Separate the preferences before proposing another round.
label.zh: 再提一轮前，先分清不同偏好。

label.en: Suggest a shorter variant if everyone wants an experiment.
label.zh: 若大家想试，提议一个短版本。

label.en: End this game and let people choose what to do afterward.
label.zh: 结束这款游戏，让各自选之后做什么。

prompt.en: Someone offers to continue just to avoid disappointing others. You…
prompt.zh: 有人说继续只是怕让别人失望，你会……

label.en: Confirm that a comfortable finish does not need an excuse.
label.zh: 确认自在结束不需要借口。

label.en: Ask what they themselves would actually choose.
label.zh: 问对方自己实际上想选什么。

label.en: Offer a small optional change without making acceptance expected.
label.zh: 提供一个小可选变化，不期待必须接受。

prompt.en: Everyone genuinely wants one more attempt. You propose…
prompt.zh: 大家确实都想再试一次，你提议……

label.en: One agreed change and a short review afterward.
label.zh: 约一处变化，之后简短再看。

label.en: A simple check that the new version fits the expressed preferences.
label.zh: 简单确认新版符合已表达偏好。

label.en: A final round with an explicit stopping point.
label.zh: 一轮有明确停止点的最后局。

prompt.en: The adjustment still does not help. You…

label.en: Let the game finish without treating the trial as failure.
label.zh: 让游戏结束，不把尝试当失败。

label.en: Ask whether the group wants anything else rather than assuming.
label.zh: 问小组是否想要别的，不自动假定。

label.en: Keep the useful observation and leave further changes for another day.
label.zh: 留有用观察，把更多修改留到以后。

label.en: One small change was tried because people actually wanted it.
label.zh: 一处小变化，是因为大家真愿意才试。

label.en: People could say what they wanted without being argued out of it.
label.zh: 大家可说想要什么，不被争辩着撤回。

label.en: The group could finish and still keep the evening pleasant.
label.zh: 群体可以结束，夜晚也仍愉快。

summary.en: Your reset starts with the preference someone actually expresses. You do not need to diagnose why the fun changed before asking what they want next. The portrait values a small check-in, not the role of permanent mediator for every group.
summary.zh: 当有人说这局不再好玩，你愿意先问问对方接下来想怎样。不必先分析为什么失去乐趣，再决定能不能商量。这只是一次小询问，不代表你需要一直做所有人的调解者。

example.en: If a friend says a puzzle round feels too long, you might ask whether they want a pause, a shorter version or an end instead of insisting the original plan should work.
example.zh: 朋友说谜题局太长，你可能问想暂停、缩短还是结束，不坚持原计划理应有效。

strength.en: A direct question can replace unsupported guessing and give the next group choice a clearer basis in what people actually want.
strength.zh: 直接询问，能减少没有依据的猜测，也让下一步安排更贴近大家实际想要的东西。

tradeoff.en: Repeated check-ins can become tiring if the answer is already clear. Accepting a stated preference can matter more than finding another way to ask it.
tradeoff.zh: 对方已经说清楚后，反复再问也会让人累。接受已经表达的偏好，有时比换一种方式继续问更重要。

experiment.en: When someone names a low-stakes preference, ask one clarifying question only if needed. Then use the answer in the next choice rather than reopening it.
experiment.zh: 别人说出一项普通活动偏好时，只在需要时澄清一次。然后把答案用在下一步安排里，不必反复重问。

summary.en: Your game reset offers a small agreed experiment rather than a complete redesign. One change can show whether the activity still has something the group wants. This ending does not make persistence automatically better than stopping.
summary.zh: 你愿意和大家商量，只改一个小地方，再看看这场游戏是否还有想继续玩的部分。不必一下重新设计全部规则。不过，尝试调整是一种选择，并不一定比直接结束更好。

example.en: A willing table might try a shorter scoring round once, then decide whether to continue based on that actual experience.
example.zh: 愿意的一桌人可以只试一轮更短计分，再按实际体验决定是否继续。

strength.en: A bounded adjustment can turn a vague hope that things improve into something the group can try and assess without a large commitment.
strength.zh: 一个小而明确的调整，能让“希望变好玩”变成大家可以实际试一试的事，不用先答应投入很多时间。

tradeoff.en: Offering one more change after every no can become pressure. A trial works only while people still want the experiment.
tradeoff.zh: 如果每次被拒绝后都再提出一个变化，提议也会变成压力。只有大家仍然愿意，继续尝试才合适。

experiment.en: For one optional shared activity, propose a single small adjustment and a clear review point. Treat declining the trial as a complete answer.
experiment.zh: 为一次可选的共同活动，提议只改一个地方，并说好什么时候再决定是否继续。对方不想试，也已经是完整的回答。

summary.en: Your reset makes finishing an ordinary possible outcome. A game can have been worthwhile without filling all the time originally reserved for it. The portrait values a clear stopping point, not giving up as a general habit or a verdict on the group.
summary.zh: 你愿意把结束也当作一次普通选择。游戏没有占满原先预留的时间，也可以是值得的经历。想停下来，不必被解释成总爱放弃，更不是对整群人的评价。

example.en: You might close a casual round, put the pieces away together and leave the remaining evening open to conversation or separate plans.
example.zh: 你可能结束这一局，和大家一起收好棋子。剩下的晚上，想聊天或各自安排，都可以。

strength.en: A comfortable finish can protect a pleasant shared memory from being stretched into obligation and let different preferences remain compatible.
strength.zh: 自在地结束，可以让一段愉快经历不必被延长成义务，也给不同的偏好留出空间。

tradeoff.en: Ending abruptly can leave a practical loose end for others. A short shared closing step can make the stop easier to use.
tradeoff.zh: 结束太突然，也可能给别人留下还没处理的小事。一起做一个简短的收尾，停下来就更方便。

experiment.en: Give one optional activity a clear closing step and then stop. Let the fact that it ended coexist with the fact that parts of it were enjoyable.
experiment.zh: 为一次可选活动安排一个清楚的收尾动作，然后就停下来。它已经结束，也不妨碍其中有过愉快的部分。

description.en: When someone says game night is no longer fun, do you check in, change one part or finish clearly? Six scenarios lead to three reset portraits with practical examples.
description.zh: 有人明确说游戏不好玩了，你会询问、改一部分或清楚结束？六个场景，阅读三种调整画像及实际例子。

question.en: Is ending a game night the same as giving up on the group?
question.zh: 结束游戏夜，就等于放弃这群人吗？

answer.en: The finish portrait concerns giving an explicitly unfun activity a clear stopping point. A check-in or bounded change can serve other situations. None requires continuing a recreational activity just to prove commitment to a group.
answer.zh: 结束画像给明确不好玩的活动一个清楚停点。询问或有限改动可服务别种情境；都不要求靠继续休闲活动来证明对团体的投入。
